description: WI pipe function. serves_customers: properties may be linked to it (rule R2). potable_network: part of the potable network the apps analyse (rule R3). confirm: an uncertain class - rows are flagged for confirmation (rule R11). serves_customers null (transmission, trunk): not fixed by the code list - the module decides (rule R2). Three main tiers, by ROLE and never by diameter (PIPE-TIERS, James 04/11): transmission = grid-type mains (a client looking at the transmission pipes sees every pipe in that part of the system; a transmission section is not given a DMA just because of a pipe's size); trunk = mains that can still sit inside a DMA with no or limited customers; distribution = the normal DMA mains. Clients differ on what they call trunk, transmission or grid, so the client's own class is recoded to one of these three in the mapping.
